chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Prayer upon me and upon my Household removes hypocrisy.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of sending Salawat upon the Prophet and his Household according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith establishes the spiritual efficacy of Salawat upon the Prophet and his Ahl al-Bayt as a means to eradicate hypocrisy (nifaq) from the heart. In Shia scholarship, this is often interpreted as a safeguard against the subtle duality of faith and disbelief, linking the purity of the Household directly to the sincerity of the believer's devotion.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘The Salawāt upon measws and upon the Peopleasws of mysaww Household removes the hypocrisy’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘Asking from Allah favors (in the form of al-Salat ) for me and my family removes hypocrisy.’”
